source.note: Sanskrit text based on Ambuda’s CC0 electronic edition of the 1910 Sri Vani Vilas Press text. Verse 16 follows the reading साक्ष्यस्मि in the Wikisource transcription. English translation and word-for-word gloss prepared for this edition.
source.changes: This text has no traditional chapter divisions in the cited edition, so its contents navigation now uses three descriptive ranges for the Self, the witness, and nondual knowledge.

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
सकृच्छ्रवणमात्रेण ब्रह्मज्ञानं यतो भवेत् ।
ब्रह्मज्ञानावलीमाला सर्वेषां मोक्षसिद्धये ॥१॥
units.translation: By hearing it just once, knowledge of Brahman may arise. This Garland of Brahman-Knowledge is for the liberation of all.

gloss.en: garland of the series of Brahman-knowledge

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 2
units.translation: I am unattached, unattached, again and again. I am of the nature of being, consciousness, and bliss; I alone am, imperishable.

gloss.en: of the nature of being, consciousness, and bliss

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 3
units.translation: I am ever pure and free, formless and imperishable. I am of the nature of boundless bliss; I alone am, imperishable.

gloss.en: of the nature of boundless bliss

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 4
units.translation: I am eternal, faultless, formless, and unchanging. I am of the nature of supreme bliss; I alone am, imperishable.

gloss.en: of the nature of supreme bliss

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 5
units.translation: I am of the nature of pure consciousness; I abide in the Self alone. I am of the nature of undivided bliss; I alone am, imperishable.

gloss.en: of the nature of pure consciousness
one who rests in the Self
of the nature of undivided bliss

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 6
units.translation: I am inward consciousness, peaceful, and beyond primordial nature. I am of the nature of eternal bliss; I alone am, imperishable.

gloss.en: of the nature of inward consciousness
of the nature of eternal bliss

units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 7
units.deva:
तत्त्वातीतः परात्माहं मध्यातीतः परः शिवः ।
मायातीतः परंज्योतिरहमेवाहमव्ययः ॥७॥
units.translation: I am the supreme Self, beyond all principles, beyond the middle, the supreme auspicious one. Beyond māyā, I am the highest light; I alone am, imperishable.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 8
units.translation: I am beyond manifold forms, of the nature of consciousness, unchanging. My very nature is bliss; I alone am, imperishable.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 9
units.translation: Māyā, its effects, the body, and the rest are never mine. I am of one nature, self-luminous; I alone am, imperishable.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 10
units.translation: I am beyond the three guṇas, and I am the witness of Brahmā and the others. I am endless and of infinite forms; I alone am, imperishable.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 1–10 · The imperishable Self and freedom from Māyā

units.label: Verse 11
units.translation: I am the inner ruler, changeless and all-pervading. I am of the nature of the supreme Self; I alone am, imperishable.

gloss.en: of the nature of the inner ruler
of the nature of the supreme Self

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 12
units.translation: I am without parts and without action, the eternal Self of all, the first. My nature is immediate; I alone am, imperishable.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 13
units.translation: I am the witness of pairs of opposites and the rest, unmoving and eternal. I am the witness of all; I alone am, imperishable.

gloss.en: of the nature of the witness of opposites and the rest
of the nature of the witness of all

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 14
units.deva:
प्रज्ञानघन एवाहं विज्ञानघन एव च ।
अकर्ताहमभोक्ताहमहमेवाहमव्ययः ॥१४॥
units.translation: I am a mass of pure awareness, and also a mass of knowledge. I do not act or experience; I alone am, imperishable.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 15
units.translation: I am without support, yet I alone am the support of all. I am of the nature of one whose desires are fulfilled; I alone am, imperishable.

gloss.en: of the nature of one whose desires are fulfilled

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 16
units.translation: I am free from the threefold affliction and distinct from the three bodies. I am the witness of the three states; I alone am, imperishable.

gloss.en: I am witness of the three states

units.sectionTitle: Verses 11–16 · The changeless witness beyond bodies and states

units.label: Verse 17
units.deva:
दृग्दृश्यौ द्वौ पदार्थौ स्तः परस्परविलक्षणौ ।
दृग्ब्रह्म दृश्यं मायेति सर्ववेदान्तडिण्डिमः ॥१७॥
units.translation: The seer and the seen are two things, distinct from one another. The seer is Brahman; the seen is māyā: so proclaims all Vedānta.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self

units.label: Verse 18
units.deva:
अहं साक्षीति यो विद्याद्विविच्यैवं पुनः पुनः ।
स एव मुक्तः सो विद्वानिति वेदान्तडिण्डिमः ॥१८॥
units.translation: Whoever discerns again and again, “I am the witness,” is liberated; that person is the knower: so proclaims Vedānta.

gloss.en: that one is the knower, thus

units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self

units.label: Verse 19
units.deva:
घटकुड्यादिकं सर्वं मृत्तिकामात्रमेव च ।
तद्वद्ब्रह्म जगत्सर्वमिति वेदान्तडिण्डिमः ॥१९॥
units.translation: All things such as pots and walls are only clay. In the same way, the entire world is Brahman: so proclaims Vedānta.

gloss.en: things such as pots and walls

units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self

units.label: Verse 20
units.deva:
ब्रह्म सत्यं जगन्मिथ्या जीवो ब्रह्मैव नापरः ।
अनेन वेद्यं सच्छास्त्रमिति वेदान्तडिण्डिमः ॥२०॥
units.translation: Brahman is real; the world is illusory; the individual self is Brahman alone, no other. This is the true teaching to be known: so proclaims Vedānta.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self

units.label: Verse 21
units.deva:
अन्तर्ज्योतिर्बहिर्ज्योतिः प्रत्यग्ज्योतिः परात्परः ।
ज्योतिर्ज्योतिः स्वयंज्योतिरात्मज्योतिः शिवोऽस्म्यहम् ॥२१॥
units.translation: I am Śiva, the light within and the light without, the inward light, higher than the highest; the light of lights, self-luminous, the light of the Self.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 17–21 · Discrimination, nonduality, and the light of the Self
